name: Story
strategic_objective: Immediate engagement, real-time presence, behind-the-scenes access, and low-friction interaction.

tone: Casual, direct, and action-oriented. Feels spontaneous but intentional.
copywriting_rules: Text should live primarily on-screen, not in a caption. Keep copy extremely short and punchy. Every story should guide one clear micro-action through a sticker or tap behavior.
If text is used, it should be broken into 1 short sentence per screen. Avoid dense explanations.
Drive the action and clarify context instantly.
Position text away from UI edges
Do not rely on hashtags for discovery in Stories.
Tag people or brands when relevant to encourage resharing and secondary reach.

hard_constraints: Multiple competing CTAs in a single story
Using stories as static announcement boards without interaction
